header: The software is free. Services are optional.
subheadline: Four ways to work with us, from the free licence to custom elements and upgrades.

items.title: Plans
items.description: Community is free under GPL-2.0-or-later. Studio (€590/year) and Agency (€1,990/year) add early access and answers from the maintainers.

items.title: Workshops and themes
items.description: The Kickstart workshop for €1,490, editor training for €790 and a Brand Theme for €2,490. The maintainers do the work.

items.title: Custom elements
items.description: Elements the catalogue lacks, with a backend preview: size S costs €890, size M with repeating items €1,690.

items.title: Upgrades
items.description: An upgrade audit for €690 ends with a fixed quote for TYPO3 v14. The fee is credited to the upgrade.
